Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.Enemy
Direct Known Subclasses:
PiratesCard, SlaverCard, SmugglerCard
public abstract class Enemy extends AdventureCard
Represents an abstract class defining the behavior and properties of an enemy card in the adventure-based game. An enemy has specific requirements for defeat, effects when encountered, and can prompt different decision-making processes for the players. This class is meant to be extended by specific types of enemy cards, each implementing its own unique behavior and effects.

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard()
      Executes the process of drawing an enemy card in the game. It invokes the base behavior of drawing a card from the superclass and then provides additional functionality specific to the Enemy class. This method prints a message to notify the player about the type of enemy encountered. It also checks the requirements needed to handle the encounter with the enemy, such as determining whether the player has sufficient firepower or necessary resources to engage effectively. Specific outcomes of the encounter are handled within the requirements check.
      Overrides:
      drawCard in class AdventureCard

    • finishDecision

      public void finishDecision(List<javafx.util.Pair<Point,Token>> coordinates)
      Processes the decision specified by the current state and the provided coordinates. Depending on the current state, this method validates the coordinates and adjusts the game progress accordingly by transitioning to the next state or handling specific effects.
      Overrides:
      finishDecision in class AdventureCard
      Parameters:
      coordinates - a list of pairs where each pair consists of a point on the board and a token representing an action or item to be used at that point during the decision-making process. - For the DECISION_BATTERIES state, it represents battery cells' coordinates. - For the DECISION_GOODS state, it represents goods to be processed. - For the DECISION_ASTRONAUTS_OR_ALIENS state, it represents crew coordinates.
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException - if the method is invoked when the current state is not one of the valid decision-making states (DECISION_BATTERIES, DECISION_GOODS, or DECISION_ASTRONAUTS_OR_ALIENS).
